monolithic_reference._note: 3-D MONOLITHIC (no-split) SBM-NS on the matched mesh — the R0 faithfulness reference. Stable and physical; recovers from the negative startup transient to a positive steady Cd.

ci_smoke_leg._note: test_g5_sphere_3d_pipeline_smoke (level-3, in-CI, ~1.5s). Gates the pipeline invariants that de-risk the 3-D composition independent of long-time stability.

verdict_detail: 3-D pipeline de-risked (composed, finite, axisymmetric, BDF2-engaged, machine-zero weak-divergence in CI). The projection SPLIT's long-time transient is unstable in 3-D (drag diverges); the monolithic on the same mesh is stable and physical (+0.381, reproducing the M1b lock). The de-risk leg is nightly + xfail with the documented finding. Remaining R2 item: a stabilized 3-D projection config, or the monolithic path for 3-D drag.
